title: conyza viscosa
intro: Conyza viscosa, commonly known as sticky fleabane or stinging fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the Mediterranean region. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Conyza viscosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
